prompt: The section headings are inconsistent. Make them all sentence case (first word capitalised, the rest lower case unless they are names).

fixture.html:
Annual review

RESULTS AND Findings

Revenue grew.

Next Steps For Acme

Plan the launch.

checks.why: headings in sentence case, keeping the name Acme
the body and title are unchanged

content.$expr: v.startsWith('Annual review') && v.includes('Revenue grew.') && v.includes('Plan the launch.')
